label: Highly distressed, heavy-use graduate-educated women
summary: This profile is characterized by elevated loneliness alongside comparatively high depressive and anxiety symptoms. It represents respondents with a heavier emotional burden across all three measured indicators.
demographic_anchor: Female respondents with graduate-level education or higher who report more than 5 hours of use.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively high loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Associated with a heavy-use pattern of more than 5 hours

label: Low distress, low loneliness profile
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate education or above, with 1–3 hours as the anchor time category.
behavior_markers: Reports lower UCLA-8 loneliness scores than more distressed profiles
Shows low average PHQ-9 depressive symptom levels
Shows very low average GAD-7 anxiety symptom levels
Represents a relatively low-distress subgroup in the sample
tone: Stable, low-distress, and socially connected overall

label: Higher loneliness with comparatively lower depression and anxiety
summary: Respondents in this profile report relatively elevated loneliness alongside comparatively lower depressive and anxiety symptoms. The pattern suggests social disconnection is more prominent than broader emotional distress.
demographic_anchor: More commonly represented by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and 1-3 hours in the referenced activity range.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness than other symptom dimensions
Shows comparatively lower depressive symptom levels
Shows comparatively lower anxiety symptom levels
Profile pattern is defined more by social disconnection than by generalized mood or anxiety burden
tone: Socially disconnected but otherwise comparatively emotionally stable
